title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Andrea Tarantini…
description: A reflected Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Andrea Tarantini Menubar up to version 5.9.4. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in the context of the affected web application.
